messages.author: 66537eeccf3193f3
messages.subject: Filter other loc.metrics
parts:
Hi,

I would like to filter loci with AvgCountRef 10-60 and FreqHets 0.2-0.6. I have tried:

gl_a5 <- gl_a4[,gl_a4@other$loc.metrics$AvgCountRef >= 10]
gl_a5 <- gl_a5[,gl_a5@other$loc.metrics$AvgCountRef <= 60]

and 

gl_a6 <- gl_a5[,gl_a5@other$loc.metrics$FreqHets >= 0.2]
gl_a6 <- gl_a6[,gl_a6@other$loc.metrics$FreqHets <= 0.6]

The first one seems to work, the second one didn't. 

Do you have any suggestions on how to do this? 

Many thanks,
Rujiporn

messages.author: a3ea45e87285d820
messages.subject: Re: Filter other loc.metrics
parts:
Hi Rujiporn,

Both of those should work, so I am not certain why the first worked and the second did not.

Were there any error messages? What did you get as a result that indicated to you that it did not work. Did you look at the contents of the metrics df to see that FreqHets was there? 

names(gl_a5@other$loc.metrics)

Can you try it doing FreqHets first and AvgCountRef second.

A

The reason it does not work is that the loci meta data is not updated due to a genlight adegenet glitch. You need to use a gl.recalc.metrics or subset the @other$loc.metrics slot by „hand“

messages.subject: Re: [dartR] Re: Filter other loc.metrics
parts:
Hi,

Just to add on from yesterday. The error that I got is actually not from the lack of SNPs but because after applying gl_a5@other$loc.metrics <- data.frame(xx=1:nLoc(gl_a5)), gl_a5 only retained AvgPIC, OneRatioRef, OneRatioSnp, PICRef, PICSnp, CallRate, FreqHets, FreqHomRef, FreqHomSnp, maf and individual genotypes while excluded everything else. So the error came from the lack of target column. After I reordered the filters, everything else worked fine. I cross-checked the final product and it behaves as I expected. 

Many thanks for all of your help.

R
